gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kannad: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, tall and loud. Noto Sans Kannada is the friendly counterweight, with a gentle step up to capitals and s curves that open wide at both ends.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kayah-: Stencil bridges and tall lowercase, loud on purpose. Noto Sans Kayah Li follows in a clean sans-serif, brush ends lifting away before curves close and capitals barely taller than the small letters.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Chunky stencil letters with wide bridges and a bold, tall build. And Noto Sans Kharoshthi supplies the surprise, its curves never closing and its lowercase running as a thick, dark stripe through each line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Expressive stencil letters with wide bridges lead, while Noto Sans Khmer follows with generous notch-like openings and small letters standing nearly capital-sized. One shouts; the other speaks.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-khudaw: Snowburst One arrives as a tall, bridged stencil sheet. Noto Sans Khudawadi sits beneath it with little gap between capital and lowercase height, its rounds left unlatched like open hooks.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-kr: Clean, contemporary Noto Sans KR keeps its curves generous. Snowburst One handles the stencil drama with tall lowercase, while the body has stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lao: Wide bridges between stencil cuts give Snowburst One its sprung, tall-lowercase attitude. And Noto Sans Lao, with its x-height pushed high and mouths open on c, e and a, can usually run a touch smaller.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lao-lo: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks, with bowls left unfinished on one side. But Snowburst One, expressive and bold in stencil form, gives the pair its loudest, most memorable quality.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha stands tall, with wide-open curves and cast-iron stature. Paired with stencil-cut Snowburst One, a long page would feel steady and approachable, never strained.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Approachable Noto Sans Limbu has gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters, set against the stencil bridges of Snowburst One. Longer text would read openly and without strain.
